regressionDiscontinuity.name: Regression discontinuity design
regressionDiscontinuity.description: An evaluation design comparing outcomes near a treatment-eligibility cutoff. Its causal interpretation depends on design assumptions and generally applies locally around that cutoff.

relationScopes.randomized: Used at one of the 18 evaluation sites; this relation does not classify the entire Reading First impact study as randomized.
relationScopes.regression: Used at 17 of the 18 evaluation sites; the study also includes one randomized site, so this is a component of a mixed design.

decision: Reuse the existing Relation-valued Study design property for concept links, with source-backed scope on each relation entity. Do not copy its unrelated legacy targets or replace the existing mixed-design Text property. RCT identity is reused; the new regression-discontinuity Topic follows complete name/alias discovery, not abbreviation-only matching.
frontendContract: A design filter matches studies containing that design component. Load each relation entity's Description and Sources so the UI does not equate containing an RCT component with being wholly randomized.
